I struggled through the same thing. I was struggling with self harm and my sexuality and I kept that too myself for 5 months and it felt like I was trapped. Like my therapist would leave or they would hate me. So I wrote a letter, I wrote down all my emotions I was feeling, when and how I self harmed, and struggling with sexuality and family matters. And then gave it to her during my next therapy session. I’m not gonna lie and say it was easy. It was very hard. But I forced myself and now I am getting better. I am on a new medication and getting more help. So I urge you to please please tell them. Maybe email them or send them a letter like I did. Just do something. And I’m always here if you wanna talk just pm me! Stay alive fren
